channel.title: Live: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Live fifth-round action from Molineux in the FA Cup as four-time winners Wolves take on eight-time winners Liverpool, with a place in the quarter-finals at stake. Wolves haven't lifted the trophy since 1960, and despite a difficult season, have improved under the guidance of Rob Edwards, who will be looking to make it a memorable night in front of a packed house on home soil.
